description:
Hushfeed v0.59.0 targets global TikTok 47.0.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

The biggest release so far, with everything built since 0.58.0 and this week's bug reports. The seek bar TikTok's experiment took away is back, Watch history works with the browser guard on, the tab names above the feed can go, a video can fill the screen, the corner LIVE button survives a filtered bottom bar, split comment view follows the fold, and the Products block in search has a switch.

Also new since 0.58.0 are Pause Hushfeed at the top of the settings, Wait a day to loosen the budget, More opens the comments, Show poll results before voting, the hold speed on Comment, Share and Favorites, Swipe-left controls, Open TikTok on, Hide mini dramas, Creator exceptions, a Network request report, a running count for saves of several files, and a long list of 47.0.3 fixes. The changelog has all of it.

Validation: 2034 runtime tests passed locally. All 421 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lint checks. All 93 patches applied to TikTok 47.0.3 and to the retained 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures, with the rebuilt resource table checked against TikTok's own and no manifest changes. Older fixtures are compatibility checks. Use 47.0.3 when patching.

The release bundle was installed on the S22 test phone over the previous build, keeping its data. The seek bar, the tab names switch, Fill the screen and the budget wait's refusals were checked there.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer. Refresh the Hushfeed source to update. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
